|game_text=If opponent just initiated a duel against one of your non-captive Jedi, deploy on that Jedi. Cancel the duel and relocate this Jedi to an adjacent site. Your duel destiny draws are each +1. (Immune to Control.)

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Effect: What Was It?, Tatooine, U
|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/whatwasit.html</ref>

There are two major types of anti-dueling cards - "escape the duel" cards and "help win the duel" cards. This Immediate Effect walks a fine line between them both!

Initially, it provides you with a duel canceler. Unlike [[A Jedi's Resilience]], though, you must make your cancel decision as the duel is initiated. This one does not give you the option to await the outcome!

But it does come with an added benefit. Now that you know your Jedi is being targeted, and your assailant has been drawn out (most likely? the duel-happy [[Darth Maul]]), use this knowledge to your advantage to put all your Jedi on high alert! All your duel destiny draws are now +1, regardless which character is under attack. And it will last as long as you can keep the Jedi with [[What Was It?]] on him alive!
|rulings=* To play this card, the adjacent site must be targeted during initiation.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=What%20Was%20It%3F</ref>
